text: Let's sketch a circuit board. The board itself: a green rectangle zone, 740 by 430, at 400,265, named Board.
CPU chip: black rectangle 120 x 90 at 360,260, label "CPU", name Cpu
memory: gray rectangle 34 wide 90 tall right of Cpu, call it Ram1
Ram2 is the same, a gray rectangle 34 by 90, 20 px right of Ram1
gold traces from Cpu to Ram1 and Ram2, plain lines
Crystal: small gray oval 20 px above Cpu, named Xtal
four tiny red circles in a row 30 px above Xtal, those are the LEDs
link the LEDs one after the other with gold lines
3 small brown rectangles in a column left of Cpu for the resistors
rename rectangle1 to R1
rectangle2 becomes R2
and call rectangle3 R3
Is R2 left of Cpu?
Battery: medium gold circle labeled 3V at 140,410, Battery.
a small blue hexagon C1 right of the battery, and C2, another small blue hexagon, right of C1
wire Battery to C1, C1 to C2 and C2 to Cpu with plain gold lines
six tiny gold squares in a column on the right side as the connector pins
group the six pins as Header
How many gold shapes are there on the board?
